newsitem.title: USA: LILCO restores power to 33,000 N.Y. users.
newsitem.headline: LILCO restores power to 33,000 N.Y. users.

text.p: Long Island Lighting Co (LILCO) restored electric service to nearly 33,000 customers after heavy winds and rain, remnants of Tropical Storm Josephine, pounded its territory Tuesday, the company said Wednesday.

"We had 35,000 customers affected island wide. We currently have 1,700 remaining without service," said company spokeswoman April Dubison, adding LILCO did not know when the remaining customers' service would resume.
The utility attributed some of the outages to snapped overhead distribution lines. "We had a lot of tree limbs with wet leaves falling on a mix of lines," Dubison said.
"Central Long Island was the hardest hit, followed by the east end (of the island)," she added.
LILCO deliveries electricity to one million customers.
